A gentle hands-on-or-near-body practice where universal life energy is channelled to support relaxation. You rest fully clothed — a lovely first step into energy healing.
Natural crystals are placed on or around the body, or used in meditation, to balance the chakras and clear emotional blockages. Sunaina selects stones to match your concern.
benefits: Let go of tension held in body and mind.
Feel lighter, calmer and more centred.
Many clients rest more deeply after sessions.
Clear the heaviness that leaves you drained.
Clear advice, including when to see a doctor.
who: People feeling stressed, drained or emotionally heavy
Those with restlessness or disturbed sleep
Anyone wanting complementary support alongside medical care
Beginners curious about energy healing
faq: How many healing sessions will I need?
It depends on the person and the concern. Many clients feel a shift after the first session; for deeper patterns a short series is usually suggested.

Yes — these practices are gentle and non-invasive. They are complementary, so continue any medical treatment your doctor has prescribed.
Do you offer online healing?
Yes. Energy work does not depend on physical distance, and many clients take distance healing over a call.
Can I learn these methods myself?
Yes. Sunaina has trained students since 2008 — see the Schedules page for upcoming classes.
